thread:
sasha (Design): quick copy pass needed for the Revoke API key confirmation modal. Current copy: `Revoke key?` with body `This will stop the key from authenticating requests.` Buttons: `Cancel` / `Revoke`. Feels terse and maybe alarming. screenshot: https://img.redwood.test/revoke-key-modal.png :warning:

helen (Product): users often worry about collateral impact (dashboards, automated jobs). we should explicitly state what breaks and whether we rotate keys automatically.

mike (Security): revoke immediately invalidates the key for auth. it will break any active integrations using that key. we do not auto-rotate; users must create a new key. also we log the event and surface it in the audit log.

andre (Eng): implementation note: we also soft-revoke for 60s allowing some grace for in-flight requests, but primarily it's immediate from an auth perspective. we can include "may affect in-flight requests" if helpful.

sasha (Design): proposed short variants (aim for clarity + calm tone):
- "Revoke API key — Immediately disables this key. Integrations using it will stop working. Create a new key to restore access. [Cancel] [Revoke key]"
- "Revoke key? This will disable the key and stop requests that use it. Audit logs will record this action. [Cancel] [Disable key]"
- "Disable this API key now. Affected services will lose access; you can create a replacement key. [Keep key] [Disable key]"
Which reads least scary but is explicit?

ben (QA): prefer first for clarity. please add a small inline link `See recovery steps` to docs. tests: ensure audit entry created, verify soft-revoke behavior (in-flight requests), and keyboard focus moves into modal. also screen reader should read full sentence including "Integrations using it will stop working."

mike (Security): wording nit: avoid words like "Disable" vs "Revoke" inconsistency. we should standardize on `Revoke` across UI and logs. also recommend adding a confirmation checkbox for high-impact keys (e.g., org-level keys) reading `I understand this will stop access for services using this key.`

helen (Product): good call. let's make the modal copy generic but add conditional UI for org keys: show the checkbox and a stronger CTA label `Revoke key` when checkbox checked. For regular keys keep simple copy to reduce friction.

sasha (Design): updated compact copy: `Revoke API key — Immediately disables this key. Integrations using it will stop working. Create a new key to restore access.` Buttons: `Cancel` and `Revoke key` (primary). For org-level keys add required checkbox text: `I understand this will stop access for services using this key.` aria-note: modal should include `role=dialog`, focus trap, and `aria-describedby` tying to the full explanation.

ci-bot: branch "revoke-key-copy" created -> PR #1189

sasha (Design): i'll push the copy + a11y checklist and mockups to the PR. thanks! :white_check_mark:
